request.subject: UNIT:DWARF:EMBARKED_TRANSPORT

layers.text: Turn it into a steam barge: the hull becomes soot-black riveted iron #3a3835 with a light grey #8a8580 rim; the red tarp becomes dark brown leather #4a3426 tied with copper bands; the pennant pole becomes a short copper #d06a2a smokestack puffing white steam; add a small bright green #2bd94a lamp. Nothing red. Keep the oars, boat shape, size, thick black outline and style the same, with nothing under the hull.
